description: Product Validation Case C (dominant channel) — Email: CVR 3.00% vs display baseline 5.03%, Below + High. Same denominator share as Display (2,500 / 100,000) but a larger gap against the leave-one-out control (4950/97500 = 0.050769...) — this pair is the concrete evidence for the core Phase 4-C finding: Evaluation High does not imply Priority High when the entity's traffic share is tiny (both entities land in the Low band despite a High Evaluation Level).
